goal: Bind connectivity evidence to versioned OS/build/radio/vendor/carrier-settings snapshots so results are never generalized from device name alone.
official_basis: Android Build / Build.VERSION for build fingerprint, incremental, security patch and radio firmware observation
Android device security state for separate system/system-modules/kernel state
Apple installed software version / About information / modem firmware
Apple Carrier Settings Version and carrier-settings update behavior
Apple system-file updates that can occur without a main OS version change
Samsung Japan current Galaxy version tables for au, docomo and manufacturer-brand devices
key_rules: Same model does not mean same software snapshot.
Same OS version does not mean same build/baseband/carrier settings.
Published latest version is not proof that a specific device installed it.
Baseband suffix is stored as a suffix only and never reconstructed into a full value.
Connectivity evidence is exact only when the tested software snapshot is explicitly observed.
Carrier operation-check evidence remains partial when exact build/baseband used in the test is not exposed.
Newer software is not assumed to improve every connectivity function.
No serial/IMEI/EID/ICCID/IMSI/MSISDN or account/activation secrets are stored.
next_phase: Phase160 LTE CA / EN-DC / NR CA combination capability and evidence model.
